I originally started hoarding years ago because I enjoy movies, TV and music very much. Then I got into computing a little more as well as audio and video production so I needed more space for samples/footage/applications. Nothing has changed except I got a seedbox and went private only for torrenting and I now I have a lot more data!
Is hoarding data your only hobby? Or possibly a result of another hobby?
Similar story to you, really. I don't have a massive amount of storage (~10TB), but I use most of it for movies, TV shows, anime, and music.

For me its not so much hoarding for the sheer sake of hoarding, but rather I think of the data as a legacy which I intend to pass on to future generations. My only concern right now is having someone from the next generation find the idea of a digital legacy interesting enough to want to "inherit" it and continue to build on what I've started.

It started the same way, with movies and tv shows in crappy resolutions downloaded from public trackers... then I discovered the wonderful world of HD, coupled with the not-so-wonderful world of slow downloads and poorly seeded torrents, so I switched over to usenet and fully automated downloads and expanded a bit into music and comics... and from there it just went downhill.

My current data hoarding revolves around keeping 720p copies of television shows that I like. Back when I played Xbox 360 all of the time I had quite a collection of games going. That was many computers ago, but I wish I still had all those 360 games just since I had such and impressive amount.
